verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm a hosted Qdrant cloud with a free-forever 1GB cluster and no credit card required, and the docs mention signup with no payment method. Private Cloud docs describe managing Qdrant clusters on your own Kubernetes infrastructure, but that is not a fully managed service. Nothing in the pack shows programmatic provisioning of managed clusters. missing for 10: evidence of a cloud management API, CLI or Terraform provider for provisioning clusters, and first-party docs describing the managed cloud service itself.
